abilities.name: Cigarette Read
abilities.description: Read a cigarette butt left at a scene and you can tell the brand, how nervous the smoker was, and how long ago they left.
abilities.cost: Needs the butt still damp or warm

growth.grows: how old a trace you can read

abilities.name: Hat-Brim Tail
abilities.description: Follow someone through a crowd at a distance and they will not notice you until you speak or they reach home.
abilities.cost: Lose them if you stop for anything

growth.grows: how wary a mark you can follow

abilities.name: Bartender's Ear
abilities.description: Sit at a bar for an hour and you can hear which booth is talking business and roughly what about.
abilities.cost: Costs the price of three drinks and a big tip

growth.grows: how much of the talk you catch

abilities.name: Hunch
abilities.description: When two clues contradict, you can sense which one was planted.
abilities.cost: The hunch keeps you awake until the case moves

growth.grows: how cleverly planted a clue it sees through

abilities.name: Leaned-On Witness
abilities.description: Speak low and steady to a scared witness and they give you one true detail they were told to forget.
abilities.cost: They will not talk to you twice

growth.grows: how frightened a witness opens up

abilities.name: Badge Flash
abilities.description: Flash an old badge and a doorman or clerk lets you through before they look closely.
abilities.cost: Works once per person; the second look always comes

abilities.name: Back-Alley Map
abilities.description: When you are chased through the city, you can always find an alley, fire escape or back door within a block.
abilities.cost: The route is never clean; expect garbage, dogs or a locked gate

growth.grows: how many ways out and how clean

abilities.name: Typewriter Tell
abilities.description: Read a typed letter and know which machine wrote it if you have seen that machine's work before.
abilities.cost: Needs a sample to compare against

abilities.name: Payroll Ghost
abilities.description: Read a company ledger and find the one name on the payroll who never shows up for work.
abilities.cost: An afternoon with the books; someone notices you looking

growth.grows: how well hidden a name you find

abilities.name: Rain Cover
abilities.description: When it rains, you can blend into any crowd of coats and umbrellas until the rain stops.
abilities.cost: Soaked to the bone; catch a cold if it goes on too long

growth.grows: how close someone can look without seeing you

abilities.name: Last Call Memory
abilities.description: Recall every face that was in a room you left, if you ask yourself before you sleep.
abilities.cost: Only the most recent room; the faces haunt your dreams

growth.grows: how many rooms back you remember

abilities.name: Wire Tap
abilities.description: Clip a borrowed handset onto a phone line and you can hear the next call made on it.
abilities.cost: Needs the line within reach; a careful caller hears the click

growth.grows: how many calls and how secure the line
